rule_line: Use `pnpm install` to set up dependencies. `pnpm dev` serves the demo playground at `http://localhost:5173` for interactive testing. Run `pnpm build` (tsdown) to produce distributable output under `dist/`, and `pnpm dev:build` or `pnpm dev:preview` when you need the Vite bundle for the demo. `pnpm typecheck` validates the library’s TypeScript contracts, `pnpm lint` applies ESLint with autofix, `pnpm format` runs Prettier, and `pnpm test` executes the Vitest suite. Use `pnpm publint` before releases to confirm the published surface.
